context_for_next_testing_agent: Beneficiary dashboard and health pages have been completely redesigned with a dark blue/teal silk background image. All 3 device types (Bracelet Elio, Balance Lefu, Gilet CareWatch) display simulated data with battery levels, vital metrics, and health tracking. The dashboard-summary API provides comprehensive data for: bracelet (HR, SpO2, BP, temp, steps, calories, distance, HR history), scale (weight, BMI, body composition, weight history), vest (posture, fall detection, wearing time), and sleep (duration, quality, phases). Navigation uses bottom tabs with Home tab showing dashboard and Health tab (or clicking vital cards) showing detailed health metrics.
